decisions.reason: The ACE3 distributed lighting control unit extends the firm's core airfield lighting control business, was launched in 2018 with strong 'new industry standard' claims, and has a long airport procurement cycle, so one year of results gives no shortfall against aspirations that would trigger problemistic search.

The air situation display builds on the established tower and surveillance offer and supports the integrated airfield-gate-tower strategy, and with little visible promotion but low marginal cost and adequate slack, management would keep it rather than drop it after only one year.
